surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the self-limited surface reactions during the ALD process, where the surface and self-limited reaction mechanism contribute to the reduced carbon incorporation and improved film qualities. The interfacial layer formation is believed to be Zr silicate and/or SiOx with the dielectric constant value at least higher than that of SiO2.
